name: Jim Webb
desc: American politician, military officer and author (born 1946)

offices.t: United States Secretary of the Navy

summary: James Henry Webb Jr. (born February 9, 1946) is an American politician and author who served as a United States senator from Virginia from 2007 to 2013. He previously served as secretary of the Navy, assistant secretary of defense for reserve affairs, counsel for the United States House Committee on Veterans' Affairs and is a retired Marine Corps officer.
